title: HELIX Terminology: Degree Level
description: Standard degree levels. Used by Program and Degree resources.

codes.definition: Sub-baccalaureate certificate (less than 1 year or 1-2 years)
Four-year baccalaureate degree (BA, BS, BFA, etc.)
Graduate-level master's degree (MA, MS, MBA, MFA, etc.)
MD, JD, DDS, PharmD, DPT, etc.
Legacy IPEDS category. Being phased into doctoral_professional.
Enrollment without pursuit of a formal credential
Short-form credential, often competency-based or industry-aligned

notes: Aligned with IPEDS degree level classifications. International profiles may map to ISCED levels (e.g., ISCED 5 = short-cycle, ISCED 6 = bachelor's, ISCED 7 = master's, ISCED 8 = doctoral).
